radius_frame: OPL_pedicle_mm; centered on fixed target H1 anchor
dynamic_cones: all L/M inside each radius; no missing-B cones silently removed
dynamic_HCs: H1 inside radius plus complete local B partners of every dynamic Cone
H2_scope: preserve H2/S geometry; exclude from H1-LM experiment only after directed-path audit
core_cones: all original direct raw contacts of target H1, same parent IDs across radii
grouping: identity fine-member groups; no centroid or coarse spatial approximation
parent_weights: same parent A/B; no renormalization after dynamic selection

convergence.rule: max_time_abs(candidate-reference) <= absolute_floor + relative_budget*max_time_abs(reference-baseline); all core rows, on/off and on-minus-off
convergence.evidence: prospective engineering acceptance budget, not a published physiological tolerance

mechanism.annulus_feedback_on_core_release_sign: positive for darkening surround contribution under this increment stimulus convention

admission: all dynamic L/M B contacts complete and nonempty; explicit background products; equation-compatible initial state
stop: retain diagnostic failure; no synthetic contact repair, no production or downstream RGC admission
external_input_limit: only this localized native-Td diagnostic and 120ms window; not natural movies
